episodes.title: Inuyasha: Since Then
episodes.summary: Towa Higurashi learns about an incident that took place decades ago involving a half demon named Inuyasha and a priestess named Kagome.

episodes.title: The Three Princesses
episodes.summary: Half-demon twins Towa and Setsuna are separated from each other when a mysterious tunnel sends Towa into the future, where she is found and raised by Kagome Higurashi's brother Sota.

episodes.title: The Dream Butterfly
episodes.summary: In the present day, a demon emerges through the Sacred Tree at Higurashi Shrine with Setsuna, Towa's twin, and the bounty hunter Moroha in tow. Towa, Setsuna, and Moroha struggle to battle the demon, whose powers have been strengthened with two Rainbow Pearls, but seeing Setsuna in trouble awakens Towa's latent demon powers.

episodes.title: The Gateway to the Past
episodes.summary: Towa decides to return to the feudal era to help Setsuna regain her memories. The trio enter the corridor leading to the feudal era, but within it awaits the spirit of a certain priestess.

episodes.title: Jakotsumaru of the Red Bone Palace
episodes.summary: Safely back in the feudal era, Moroha heads to the corpse dealer to claim her bounty. Meanwhile, Towa and Setsuna take on a request to slay Jakotsumaru, a boy who has been extracting bones from humans and beasts in order to revive his father, the demon beast Tokotsu.

episodes.title: The Cat Juan at the Old Temple
episodes.summary: Travelers are going missing one after another. Towa, Setsuna, and Moroha head to the northern mountains to crack the case, but instead they find a village completely overrun by ghost cats!

episodes.title: Meeting Through an Apple
episodes.summary: On her way to search for the Dream Butterfly, Towa meets a strange young man named Riku. Towa offers him an apple, and in thanks, Riku presents her with the genuine Kikujumonji sword.

episodes.title: The Dream Gazing Trap
episodes.summary: The owl demon Yotsume flees the deputy shogun's estate to the lair of Kyuki, a member of the Four Perils. Kyuki lends Yotsume a Rainbow Pearl to help him unleash his Dream Gazing spell upon the Half-Demon Princesses, who are hot on his trail.

episodes.title: Meifuku, the Meioju
episodes.summary: Moroha accepts a job to slay Konton, a member of the Four Perils said to have defeated Meioju, a demon beast with the ultimate armored shell.

episodes.title: The Gold and Silver Rainbow Pearls
episodes.summary: The Half-Demon Princesses are tasked with slaying Kinka and Ginka, conjoined twins of the Ka Demon Tribe whose battles for dominance have been wreaking havoc everywhere.

episodes.title: Curse of the Man-Eating Pond
episodes.summary: Something wicked lurks in the Man-Eating Pond, devouring any human, beast or bird that comes near. On their way to slay the creature, Towa and Setsuna meet Hikomaru and Chiyo, siblings who lost their parents to the pond.

episodes.title: Night of the New Moon and the Black-haired Towa
episodes.summary: Nikosen was a sage before evil consumed his soul and transformed him into a demon. Konton orders him to kill the Half-Demon Princesses. Nikosen's ambush catches Towa at a bad time, when her demon powers are fading and she is slowing turning into a human.

episodes.title: The Delicious Feudal Monks
episodes.summary: Tōtetsu, the final member of the Four Perils, has been wrecking havoc by devouring high-level Shinto monks and priests to attain their increasingly powerful spiritual abilities. One of his targets is none other than Miroku, Hisui's father! Can the Half-Demon Princesses and demon-slayers reach him in time before Tōtetsu devours him?

episodes.title: The One Behind the Forest Fire
episodes.summary: Towa and Setsuna set off to slay Homura, an evil mountain god who has abducted a beautiful maiden named Tamano. However, Homura is shocked at the sight of the twins; it turns out that he was involved in the forest fire that separated them ten years ago.

episodes.title: Farewell Under the Lunar Eclipse
episodes.summary: Riku recalls events that took place beginning 18 years ago, when Inuyasha receives a new Black Pearl. 4 years later, on the night of Towa and Setsuna's birth, Inuyasha and Sesshomaru learn of a cataclysmic event that needs to be stopped.

episodes.title: Double-Edged Moroha
episodes.summary: Konton barters with Yawaragi, Moroha's former master, to take Moroha's life in exchange for an item she seeks. Yawaragi appears before Moroha, and a showdown between master and pupil begins.

episodes.title: Trap of the Two Perils
episodes.summary: Riku informs Towa, Setsuna, and Moroha about the whereabouts of Totetsu and they set out to slay him. In their pursuit, Totetsu leads them to a ravine where, unbeknownst to the girls, Konton has set up a trap to ensnare and destroy them.

episodes.title: Sesshomaru and Kirinmaru
episodes.summary: Towa and Setsuna break free from Konton's trap and defeat him. They meet up with Moroha to finish off Totetsu, but he flees the battle. The girls chase after him but are suddenly attacked and find themselves face to face with Kirinmaru.

episodes.title: Princess Aiya's Beniyasha hunting
episodes.summary: The demon slayers are offered a chance to be employed by the deputy shogun, but they must battle against a group of bounty hunters, which includes Moroha. Not wanting Towa to get involved, the two parties try to keep the battle a secret.

episodes.title: The Hidden Village for Half Demons
episodes.summary: While on the lookout for demons deep in the mountains, Setsuna reveals to Towa what occurred during the 10 years they were separated.

episodes.title: Secret of the Rainbow Pearls
episodes.summary: On the night of the new moon, Towa is visited by Riku and he reveals his intentions of gathering all seven of the Rainbows Pearls. During their conversation, Totetsu suddenly appears to attack the currently powerless Towa.

episodes.title: The Stolen Seal
episodes.summary: Zero appears before the girls and removes the seal suppressing Setsuna's demon powers. When Setsuna transforms and loses control, Towa and Moroha struggle to stop her rampage.

episodes.title: The Three Princesses Strike Back
episodes.summary: Towa and Setsuna hire Moroha to assist them with slaying Zero. They go to the location where the Great Dog Demon had perished long ago and find Zero, but Riku is there to defend her.

episodes.title: Sesshomaru's Daughter
episodes.summary: Kirinmaru arrives and intervenes in the battle by scattering the Rainbow Pearls. Zero, enraged with her brother, cuts ties with him and flees. Sesshomaru chases after her, leaving Towa, Setsuna, and Moroha to face off against Kirinmaru.

episodes.title: What It Means to Wield Tenseiga
episodes.summary: Jaken, Kirara, Mō-Mō, Moroha, Sesshōmaru, Setsuna, Tōtōsai, and Towa are in the war zone. During Towa's first attempt to use Tensaiga, she encounters The Dream Butterfly, which communicates Rin and The Tree Of Ages, and flies towards them. Not long after they are surrounded by Devils From The Underworld. Greatly Outnumbered, Moroha and Tōtōsai forge a Sword for Setsuna and takes the burnt out Tensaiga in for repairs.

episodes.title: Demon Spirit of the Sea
episodes.summary: Remembering what Tōtōsai said about Towa being vulnerable, Setsuna goes with Moroha to find the Elements needed to Forge a new Sword. The lady that they seek takes notice of Setsuna's beauty and plots revenge. Towa and Riku join the side of Setsuna and Moroha while Setsuna detects the final thoughts of a man that accidentally killed each other from a misunderstanding. The ghost Ghost Devil hears the man's final thoughts and finally ascends. Riku prepares himself to search for the Elements that they need.

episodes.title: The Silver-Scale Curse
episodes.summary: Jaken recalls that fateful day fourteen years ago, when Zero placed a curse on Rin that would make her slowly rot away to an excruciating death. The three girls search for Bokusen-Oh, who may have a lead on the whereabouts of Towa's new weapon.

episodes.title: The Barrier at Mount Musubi
episodes.summary: To get their hands on the famous spiritual root, the three Yasha princesses must enter a territory surrounded by a powerful barrier. This will be an opportunity for them to ask themselves certain questions, but above all to obtain valuable answers.

episodes.title: The Girl Named Rion
episodes.summary: Rion used to travel the world with her father Kirinmaru, but one day, her soul was sealed deep within Mount Musubi. Longing for freedom and peace, Rion asks Setsuna to sever the thread of fate that connects her to her father.

episodes.title: Hisui the Demon Slayer
episodes.summary: Setsuna is kidnapped by Princess Aiya, daughter of the deputy shogun. Wanting to escape her studies, Princess Aiya begs Setsuna to be her body double for a day, but the princess's new tutor turns out to be Hisui posing as his older sister Kin'u!

episodes.title: Takechiyo's Request
episodes.summary: Revealing that he was once the young lord of the Mamidaira Clan, Takechiyo hires Moroha as a bodyguard to help him with the familial strife at his home. During training, Kohaku teaches Towa an important lesson about learning to run away.

episodes.title: Nanahoshi's Small Galaxy
episodes.summary: Zero sets a trap in the garden of Nanahoshi, a demon who feeds on sadness. Kirinmaru pays Towa, Riku, and Rion a visit. Kohaku, Hisui, and Setsuna assist the chief of the demon slayers in the north.

episodes.title: Mayonaka the Visitor
episodes.summary: Riku is able to open his eyes again. He Towa's lavender hand cream in an attempt to store his vision. Does scent really impact his vision, or does he Only Have Eyes For Towa? Hachiemon and Takechiyo rescue Moroha. Setsuna frees Mahiruma and The Blessing Of The Five Grains from Gokoku.

episodes.title: Decisive Battle of the New Moon (1)
episodes.summary: Moroha learns about her parents' battle against Shogen Mamiana, the sealing of the Full Moon Raccoon Dog, and Takechiyo's exile from his clan. Setsuna is attacked by the snow demon Yukinyudo. Zero targets Towa on the new moon.

episodes.title: Decisive Battle of the New Moon (2)
episodes.summary: Moroha and Takechiyo strike back against Shogen Mamiana. Setsuna experiences her first New Moon. Towa is trapped by Nanahoshi's eternity bugs.

episodes.title: A Place (Not) for Towa
episodes.summary: Zero unearths Towa's sadness about growing up in the modern world and corners her with her memories of loneliness and suffering. Sesshomaru appears before the demon slayers and commands Setsuna to pay the Tree of Ages a visit.

episodes.title: Zero's Feelings
episodes.summary: Towa is consumed by rage and loneliness. Setsuna tries to stop her from killing Zero because the curse on their mother cannot be lifted unless Zero lets go of her regrets. Sesshomaru gives Moroha the Black Pearl.

episodes.title: Kirinmaru of the Dawn
episodes.summary: Kirinmaru takes the Black Pearl from Moroha and demands that she bring Akuru to him. Towa and Setsuna try to lend a hand, but Sesshomaru arrives at the scene to take on Kirinmaru instead. Meanwhile, Rion and Riku head to Mount Musubi.

episodes.title: Moroha and Family, Together Again
episodes.summary: Inside the Black Pearl, Moroha is finally reunited with her parents, Inuyasha and Kagome. Inuyasha begins to see a way out of the Black Pearl. Meanwhile, Kirinmaru's attack leaves Sesshomaru gravely injured.

episodes.title: The Three Princesses Escape
episodes.summary: Wanting to prove his strength, Kirinmaru faces off against Sesshomaru. Towa summons the Tenseiga. Shippo waits for Inuyasha and the others at Gozu and Mezu's gate.

episodes.title: Akuru's Pinwheel
episodes.summary: In the present day, Osamu Kirin sees the Grim Comet approaching. Meanwhile, in the feudal era, Towa's life is in danger after she uses her Zanseiken. The Spirit of the Tree of Ages orders the half-demon princesses to go destroy the Grim Comet.

episodes.title: The Collapse of the Windmill of Time
episodes.summary: To destroy the Grim Comet, Towa, Moroha, and Setsuna must travel to the present day using the Windmill of Time, but Meidomaru stands in their way. Kirinmaru takes Rion and tries to travel across time by force.

episodes.title: The Blackout
episodes.summary: Osamu Kirin has been quietly exterminating the demons that have been appearing in the present day. He asks Towa, Setsuna, and Moroha to slay demons at the concert that is happening.

episodes.title: When the Grim Comet Falls
episodes.summary: Inuyasha and the others have their hands full with the evil spirits pouring out of the burning Windmill of Time. The three girls and Osamu Kirin try to stop the Grim Comet from falling to the earth.

episodes.title: Osamu Kirin's Demonic Punishment
episodes.summary: Osamu Kirin brings the Grim Comet to the feudal era. He convinces Rion that they are both hoping for the same world and promises to make it a reality. Meanwhile, Towa, Setsuna, and Moroha are stuck in the present day.

episodes.title: The Grim Butterfly of Despair
episodes.summary: Towa, Setsuna, and Moroha must save Rion, who has linked her fate with the Grim Butterfly, but Osamu Kirin stands in their way. Kirin declares that he and Rion should reign over the world in order to bring about true peace.

episodes.title: Father and Daughter
episodes.summary: Setsuna directs Towa and Moroha as they continue to sever Rion's threads of fate. Each time a thread is severed, more of Rion's true feelings are revealed. As Kirinmaru fights Sesshomaru, he realizes the real reason he lost Rion.

episodes.title: A Never-Ending Future
episodes.summary: The feudal era is saved from the Degenerate Age. Inuyasha helps repay Moroha's remaining debt. Towa and Setsuna receive kimonos from their mother, Rin. Towa, Setsuna, and Moroha accept a demon-slaying request from a mysterious man.
